chapter: Erroll Garner, the 1952 arrest and Florida
title: Looking back on changing styles
summary: Music changes every ten to twenty years from ragtime to the avant garde.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Uh-huh. Yeah. Well, like this song with the same name, 'Looking Back'. Just about all of my compadres have departed, you know.

Like we said music has a tendency to change every ten to twenty years. Like there was ragtime, changed to dixieland, then it changed to swing, then to be-bop, then the avant-cool school, and then the avant garde. And I don't know what they name it now, what they call it.
